verdict.rationale: Rootly ships AI features, so a no-training data guarantee is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack has nothing on whether customer data is used for model training, and no documented training opt-out. The closest item is the AI settings page, which offers a team-wide AI opt-in and per-feature toggles. That governs whether AI features run at all, not whether data trains models, so it is an adjacent control and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
